sv.title: Asylboendet i Lund kan vara lika hotfullt som båtresan över Medelhavet
sv.summary: De kända fotograferna Tina Enghoff och Kent Klichs utställning på Skissernas museum handlar om flyktingars erfarenheter i Sverige och Danmark.

en.title: The asylum accommodation in Lund may be as threatening as the boat trip across the Mediterranean
en.summary: Well-known photographers Tina Enghoff and Kent Klich's exhibition at Skissernas museum deals with refugees' experiences in Sweden and Denmark.
